articles.summary: Janus Living, Inc. (NYSE: JAN) (“Janus Living”), a pure-play senior housing real estate investment trust (REIT), announced results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. THIRD QUARTER 2026 FINANCIAL PERFORMANCE AND RECENT HIGHLIGHTS (all percentage changes compare third quarter 2026 to third quarter 2025 unless otherwise noted) Net loss of $(0.02) per share FFO as Adjusted of $0.25 per share increased 46% Consolidated revenues of $268 million increased 78% and Adjusted EBITDAre of $105 million increased 101% Same-store adjusted NOI increased 25.9% and margin expanded 360 basis points (“bps”) Same-store revenues increased 9.8% driven by 300 bps of average occupancy growth and 6.5% revenue per occupied room (“RevPOR”) growth Record third quarter non-refundable entrance fee sales of $47 million Acquired 33 senior housing communities for approximately $1.75 billion From July 1 through August 3, as previously disclosed, completed approximately $1.0 billion of senior housing acquisitions
articles.title: Janus Living Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results and Increases Full Year 2026 Guidance
